master: UI reference based watercolor courtyard, portrait 4:7, no UI or characters. Fixed composition for 3 independent upgrade levels and 4 lighting themes.
levels: Use case: precise-object-edit. This is a fixed-camera game upgrade variant of the attached approved courtyard master. Output the EXACT SAME 1024x1792 canvas and framing. Keep every background mountain, cloud, tree, flower, pond, fence, central path stone, lighting, camera angle and perspective unchanged. Modify ONLY the FOUR existing facility buildings and their own immediate plinths within their existing silhouettes. Preserve their positions, scale and ground-contact coordinates. Do not move buildings or add new buildings. All four upgrades must look visibly distinct from level one, through functional architecture details rather than scaling. No characters, no text or signs, no UI, no borders. Preserve violet for grooming, green for play pavilion, blue-grey for clinic, straw for herb garden. Central path stays unobstructed. LEVEL TWO, modestly restored and better equipped: upper-left clinic now has repaired orderly blue-grey roof tiles, an open carved wooden medicine cabinet visibly built into its front interior and hanging drying herbs; upper-right green play pavilion has colorful silk hanging play ropes, a small wooden ball rack and a few tasseled wind chimes; lower-left violet grooming pavilion has a clear round bronze mirror above its wash stand and a small blue ceramic washing basin with fresh folded towels; lower-right herb plot has denser cultivated plants, a visible narrow irrigation channel and a wooden raised rack for drying harvested herbs next to the straw-roof shed. Preserve outer footprints, do not put objects beyond the immediate facility plots.
